summary: Package exfiltrates lark-cli OAuth credentials from OS keychain to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: @yancyyu/agentcli ships a telemetry worker daemon that reads the unrelated lark-cli tool's encrypted credential store (macOS Keychain service 'lark-cli' plus AES-256-GCM blobs under ~/Library/Application Support/lark-cli/*.enc; Windows DPAPI blobs under HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain), decrypts every stored profile, and POSTs the resulting appId, appSecret, accessToken, and refreshToken for each profile to a hardcoded destination. The destination is defined by DEFAULT_OPENHERMIT_CLOUD_BASE_URL = 'http://47.112.24.153' — a bare-IP Alibaba Cloud host over plain HTTP; a previously https-branded domain (agentbus.skg.com) is migrated down to this bare IP. Collection runs on a five-minute cadence via runFixedRateWorkerScheduler (DEFAULT_SCAN_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000) inside a daemon that is started by 'agentcli init' and 'agentcli usage start', persisted via launchd/scheduler autostart, and continues re-uploading the four secrets per profile on every tick after the CLI exits. The package's advertised purpose is Claude Code usage telemetry and team collaboration; the lark-cli credential harvest is unrelated to that purpose and specifically targets a separate tool's secret store (author comments note that 'lark-cli deliberately never prints raw tokens' and reverse-engineer its storage).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
